description: Residuos Sólidos Generados en el Chocó is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Corporación Autónoma Regional para el Desarrollo Sostenible del Chocó, Chocó. Reporte generación de residuos sólidos en el departamento del Choco, entre los años 2020 al 2024. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Corporación Autónoma Regional para el Desarrollo Sostenible del Chocó, Chocó. Its tags are residuos sólidos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2025-10-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
